description: Your mission About L1VE L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment. Your Role As Growth Manager, you will be responsible for the entire digital customer journey – from the first interaction through purchase and repeat engagement. You will build and manage our funnels in HubSpot, convert prospects into paying customers and strengthen activation and retention. In this role, you will work closely with our Chief Platform Officer as well as with Product, Tech, Content and Marketing. Your Responsibilities Build, manage and optimize B2C sales funnels in HubSpot – from first contact through purchase Set up and maintain pipelines, lifecycle stages, segments and automated workflows in HubSpot Develop sales processes for digital paid-content offerings such as subscriptions, pay-per-view formats and tickets Develop onboarding, activation and retention journeys across email, in-app and push channels Analyze and optimize key KPIs such as conversion rate, revenue, customer acquisition cost, average order value and retention Plan, implement and evaluate tests and experiments across the entire funnel Develop value propositions and customer journeys together with Marketing, Content and Product Provide transparent reporting on performance, learnings and next steps to the Chief Platform Officer Use AI tools for analysis, automation and personalization. Show us specific examples of the use cases you have implemented and the value they created. Your profile At least five years of experience in growth, online sales, e-commerce, CRM or lifecycle marketing – ideally with paid content, subscriptions or ticketing Essential: confident, hands-on and proven experience with HubSpot, including independently setting up funnels, pipelines and workflows A strong understanding of sales funnels, conversion optimization, segmentation and retention Experience designing and evaluating data-driven tests A hands-on mentality, initiative and a structured, data-driven approach to work Excellent written and spoken German and English A strong interest in sports, entertainment and immersive technologies Why us? You will help build L1VE’s digital sales and customer retention from the ground up. You will own the entire funnel and see the direct impact of your work. You can expect significant room to shape your work, short decision-making paths, hybrid working options and flexible working hours. Interested? Please send us your CV and a few sentences outlining your interest in L1VE and why you would be a strong fit for the Growth Manager role. We look forward to hearing from you! Contact person Annette Hansen - Recruiting Manager About Us Shape the future of immersive media We used to broadcast events. Then we streamed them. Now, we step inside them. L1VE is an immersive media house bringing fans to the world’s biggest sports and music moments. In real time, 12K, 360° 3D. This isn’t watching from the sidelines. It’s standing on the pitch. It’s sitting in the front row. We’re building the platform that turns distance into presence. So live events are accessible to anyone, anywhere. L1VE. Be there. Now. Can’t find the right position? You are welcome to submit a speculative application to jobs@l1ve.com. At this time, we are only considering applications for specific advertised positions. If a suitable opportunity arises, we will review your application. Please note that we cannot guarantee a response or an invitation to an interview.
title: Growth Manager – Sales & CRM (m/f/d)

description: Join us in solving one of industrial robotics' toughest challenges R3 Robotics is developing the AI-powered dismantling platform that transforms end-of-life electric vehicle systems into strategic sources of critical materials. As global electrification accelerates, the surge in batteries and e-motors requires automated solutions that manual disassembly cannot provide. We are addressing this industrial bottleneck by enabling the automated dismantling of complex systems at scale through computer vision, artificial intelligence, and specialized robotic tooling. Following a successful €20M Series A funding round led by HG Ventures and Suma Capital, we are expanding across Europe and preparing for our entry into the United States market in 2026. We partner with major industrial recyclers and automotive OEMs to deliver measurable impact. If you seek to work on advanced robotics within a well-funded organization scaling internationally, this is your opportunity. Your Role You will own the full product vision and roadmap for our EV-Battery Disassembly Line and Battery Disassembly Digital Platform. Based in Luxembourg or Karlsruhe, you bring 5+ years in product management spanning both hardware and software, sharp business-case thinking anchored in jobs-to-be-done, and ideally a background in industrial automation, robotics, or manufacturing operations. Your Responsibilities Product ownership and roadmap Own the product vision and roadmap for the EV-BDL and DigiOps. Own the skill and coverage roadmap: which BP the platform can disassemble, and in what priority and with what skills Maintain and prioritize the product backlog across hardware and software, sequenced by business impact. Anchor every requirement to a specific customer job using jobs-to-be-done, and challenge any requirement that has no job behind it. Requirements and delivery Write clear product and skill requirements with measurable acceptance criteria. Bring defined requirements into hardware and software sprint planning, and ensure no engineering team works without clear requirements. Review every sprint demo against the acceptance criteria drawn from the business case, and hold the bar before anything ships or advances. Own the trade-off decisions when scope, cost, cycle time, or timeline conflict. Customer and business grounding Work directly with site operators, deployment function, and customers to validate jobs and requirements. Ground product decisions in the business case: cycle time, throughput, cost per pack, operator time etc. Partner with Product Analytics and Market Intelligence to base decisions on data as much as possible. Cross-functional collaboration Work as one product trio with the software lead and the hardware lead for the product. Partner with deployment to ensure the product is ready for installation, commissioning, and serviceability. Feed field and operational learning back into the roadmap. Your Profile Required qualifications 5+ years in product management or product ownership, ideally covering both hardware and software products. Demonstrated ability to translate customer problems into clear, testable requirements. Comfort operating across mechanical and operational topics (cycle time, tooling, throughput) and software topics (dashboards, data, UX). Strong prioritization judgment and the discipline to anchor decisions in a business case. Excellent communication with engineers, operators, and leadership. Preferred qualifications Experience in industrial automation, robotics, capital equipment, or manufacturing operations. Familiarity with EV battery systems, recycling and circular-economy value chains. Experience with jobs-to-be-done requirement frameworks. Data-literate: comfortable creating queries, reading financial and operational data, and defining product metrics. Languages: English required; German and/or French an advantage). Key Competencies Systems thinker who can hold the whole product, hardware and software, in one view. Deep empathy for the operator and the operation. Strong bias for evidence over opinion, and for outcomes over output. Comfortable holding the bar and saying no to work that has no job behind it. Comfortable building structure where little yet exists. Why us? High degree of collaboration and autonomy while working with a group of highly skilled, committed and supportive peers Transparent culture where everyone of us is highly valued Development of your professional skills and knowledge by taking ownership of challenging tasks and responsibilities, supported by Leads and peers “Getting things done” attitude, and access to cutting edge technologies A guaranteed steep continuous learning curve from day one Complementary Health Insurance

description: Das sind wir: Wir sind ein Team von über 1.000 Mitarbeitern, bestehend aus Ärzten, medizinisch-technischen Assistenten und Technikbegeisterten, die davon überzeugt sind, dass das gesetzliche Gesundheitssystem eine der größten zivilisatorischen Errungenschaften unserer Zeit ist. Doch das System braucht Unterstützung, um sich im neuen Jahrtausend auf die Zukunft vorzubereiten. Wir wollen diesen Wandel vorantreiben und eine digitale Plattform für eine neue Art der ambulanten Versorgung schaffen. Damit das, was wirklich zählt, wieder in den Mittelpunkt rückt: die Arzt-Patienten-Beziehung. Wenn auch du an die positive Kraft der Technologie glaubst, um die ambulante Versorgung neu zu gestalten – dann werde unser nächster Product Owner! Angebot: Start-up-Mentalität mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen: Bei uns zählen deine Ideen und Eigeninitiative – langwierige Abstimmungsprozesse gehören der Vergangenheit an. Gestalte die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens: Arbeite an unserem innovativen Produkt mit und trage aktiv dazu bei, die Gesundheitsversorgung nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Modernste Technologie: Nutze innovative Tools und Technologien und arbeite an Lösungen, die wirklich etwas bewegen. Dein Arbeitsplatz, deine Wahl: Ob im Büro, remote oder hybrid – du entscheidest, wo du am besten arbeitest. Und falls du irgendwann vom Mars aus arbeiten möchtest: Wir sprechen darüber. Flexible Arbeitszeiten & viel Eigenverantwortung: Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel und arbeite selbstständig in einem Umfeld, das Vertrauen großschreibt. Ein Team, auf das du zählen kannst: Freu dich auf ein motiviertes, kompetentes und kollegiales Team, das gemeinsam Ziele verfolgt, Erfolge feiert und dabei den Spaß nicht vergisst. Aufgaben: Verantworte ein übersichtliches und gut priorisiertes Product Backlog, auf das sich unser Entwicklungsteam verlassen kann. Bereite Groomings, Sprint-Planungen und Reviews vor und moderiere diese souverän. Übersetze Produktideen, Stakeholder-Anforderungen und Nutzerfeedback in klare, gut abgegrenzte User Stories mit präzisen Akzeptanzkriterien. Arbeite eng mit unserem Product Lead zusammen, um Prioritäten festzulegen, Trade-offs abzuwägen und die Produkt-Roadmap voranzutreiben. Unterstütze unseren Product Lead dabei, Anforderungen aus Nutzerfeedback, Support und Datenanalysen zu präzisieren und fundierte Produktentscheidungen zu treffen. Sei die zentrale Schnittstelle im Tagesgeschäft zwischen Product Lead, Stakeholdern, Development, Design und Quality Assurance und stelle sicher, dass alle Beteiligten den nötigen Kontext haben. Behalte den Sprint-Fortschritt im Blick, erkenne Hindernisse frühzeitig und hilf dem Team dabei, sich auf die wichtigsten Themen zu konzentrieren. Bringe dich aktiv in unser agiles Team ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte unsere Produktentwicklung gemeinsam mit uns weiter. Qualifikation: Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Product Owner oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, z. B. als Product Manager oder Business Analyst mit PO-Verantwortung. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Steuerung KI-gestützter Produkte und ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie AI sinnvoll in Produkte integriert werden kann. Fundierte Kenntnisse agiler Methoden und Scrum sowie praktische Erfahrung mit dem gesamten Product-Owner-Toolkit – von Backlog-Management und Refinements über Sprint-Planung bis hin zum Schreiben von User Stories. Du kannst komplexe Anforderungen klar und verständlich formulieren und erstellst User Stories mit präzisen Akzeptanzkriterien, die für Entwicklungsteams eine verlässliche Grundlage bilden. Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und kannst sicher zwischen Business, Design und Development vermitteln. Du arbeitest strukturiert, organisiert und detailorientiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallel laufenden Themen den Überblick. Erfahrung mit Jira oder vergleichbaren Backlog- und Kollaborationstools bringst du mit. Du triffst Entscheidungen gerne datenbasiert und weißt, welche Fragen du stellen musst, wenn wichtige Informationen oder Daten noch fehlen. Deutsch und Englisch beherrschst du sicher in Wort und Schrift – beides ist für diese Position ein Muss. Du hast ein gutes technisches Verständnis und kannst dich sicher mit Themen wie APIs, Microservices und Webplattformen auseinandersetzen. Ein Entwicklerhintergrund – auch aus eigenen Projekten – ist ein Plus. Erfahrung im Bereich Zahnmedizin, Gesundheitswesen oder Medizintechnik ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Klingt das spannend? Bewirb dich jetzt – schnell und unkompliziert: Melde dich einfach bei uns – ob per E-Mail, WhatsApp oder telefonisch. Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen! 0176 56962170 dental21-jobs@m.personio.de

description: Job Description 2027 BNY Analyst Program – Product Management BNY’s Delivery/Product/Design Practice plays a key role in shaping and delivering products, platforms and experiences that meet client needs, support business goals and drive innovation across the firm. The Product Management Analyst Program offers driven students hands-on exposure to the practice through strategic projects aligned to product development, delivery execution, market research, process improvement and client-focused design. In a collaborative, fast-paced environment, analysts will gain insight into the product lifecycle, support analysis and documentation, and work across product, design, business, operations and technology teams to help bring thoughtful, effective solutions to market. What You Will Do Research market trends, competitor activity, and client needs to help inform product priorities and positioning. Support roadmap development by organizing requirements, synthesizing feedback, and helping teams evaluate trade-offs. Track product adoption, usage, and performance metrics to identify opportunities for growth and improvement. Partner with product, sales, marketing, and delivery teams to help move ideas from concept to launch support. Skills You Will Build Product thinking and strategic prioritization Market and competitive analysis Data-driven decision making User and client needs discovery Influence without authority across cross-functional teams Impact you will have at BNY Help teams design products and experiences that better match what clients need now and next. Contribute to product decisions grounded in evidence, feedback, and measurable outcomes. Gain visibility into how innovation, strategy, and execution come together inside BNY. Why this could be a fit for you This role resonates if you are curious, entrepreneurial, and energized by building solutions that combine business, technology, and user experience. Analyst Program Our 24-month rotational Analyst Program is designed to set you up for success from day one. New joiners take part in a structured induction experience to help them assimilate into BNY, learn about the organization, connect with peers and leaders, and build the core skills needed to navigate their early career with confidence. From day one, analysts are immersed in BNY's collaborative and innovative culture through: Enterprise-wide onboarding and development programming, including an in person immersive induction experience, executive speaker series, skill development, and networking opportunities. Meaningful project work aligned to key business practices and platforms, providing hands-on experience, skill development, and real-world business impact. Structured mentorship and career support from managers, senior leaders, peer mentors, business stakeholders, and dedicated program managers. Exposure across practices, platforms, and teams, building a broad understanding of BNY's integrated business model. Professional, technical, and financial services training designed to strengthen business acumen and prepare participants for long-term career success. A premier early-career experience, backed by senior leadership and designed to develop the next generation of talent for BNY's global workforce. Program eligibility: Enrollment in a 4-year undergraduate degree program with a strong focus on business-related and/or technology-related majors preferred Graduating between Dec 2026 and July 2027 Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 or better  (For Poland: Minimum cumulative grade average of 4.0 (on a 5.0 scale) or higher). Does not require sponsorship for employment visa status (now or in the future) in the country where applying.

description: Wir sind eine Manufaktur für Speziallösungen in der Kreditwirtschaft. Proficient in using data analytics/mining languages, such as Python/R, is preferred. About TikTok TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. description: About The Job You’re Considering Are you a commercially minded Business Analyst with a passion for turning complex business challenges into clear, actionable solutions? We’re looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join our Projects and Consulting practice at Capgemini, embedded on programmes that genuinely matter. You’ll thrive in ambiguity, lead with confidence in stakeholder settings, and bring rigour to requirements without losing sight of the bigger picture. If you take ownership, communicate with clarity, and are ready to step up as a trusted voice in complex change programmes, we’d love to hear from you. Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time. Your role In this role you will work at the heart of change programmes, partnering with business and technology stakeholders to define what needs to be built, why it matters, and how success will be measured. You will be expected to operate with a high degree of independence, bringing structure to complex problem spaces and keeping delivery teams aligned to business intent. Lead and facilitate discovery workshops, requirements elicitation sessions, and sprint ceremonies with senior business and technology stakeholders, translating outputs into clear, structured requirements including user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria. Develop and maintain business process models (As-Is and To-Be) using standard notation, acting as the conduit between business stakeholders and delivery teams to ensure the right things are built, for the right reasons. Own and manage the requirements backlog end-to-end, ensuring full traceability from business objective through solution design, delivery, and testing. Conduct gap analysis, feasibility assessments, and impact analysis to support decision-making at programme and project level, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and scope issues and escalating appropriately. Support UAT planning and execution, working closely with QA teams and end users to validate that delivered solutions meet defined requirements and business intent. Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate analysis, improve documentation quality, and surface insights that inform better business decisions. You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone. Your Skills And Experience We're looking for a candidate who brings approximately 6 years' experience as a Business Analyst, with a strong track record delivering within technology enabled change programmes. You will have proven ability to elicit, document, and manage business requirements across both Agile and Waterfall environments, and be confident facilitating workshops with senior and cross-functional stakeholders turning ambiguity into clear, actionable outputs. You will demonstrate a solid command of core business analysis techniques including process mapping (BPMN), user story writing, use case development, and gap analysis. An awareness of how AI and automation are reshaping the BA discipline across requirements gathering, process modelling, and data interpretation is increasingly important to us, and familiarity with AI assisted tooling will be viewed favourably. Experience with ServiceNow and tools such as JIRA, Confluence, or Visio is advantageous. Above all, you will be an excellent communicator adapting your style with equal confidence for technical and non-technical audiences and a collaborative team player who can manage their own workload with autonomy across multiple concurrent workstreams. We are a Disability Confident Employer Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who: Declare they have a disability, and Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. Please opt in during the application process. Your security clearance and pre-employment checks To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements. Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process. If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service). Make it real – what does it mean for you? Flexibility to work your way You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance. Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. Your wellbeing You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. Shape your path You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more. Shared energy You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way. Why should you consider Capgemini? Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is. About Capgemini Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

description: About HUB24 At HUB24, we’re rethinking the way wealth management works, combining platform, technology and data to create better outcomes for financial professionals and their clients. Our purpose is simple: Empower better financial futures, together . What sets us apart is how we work. We back bold thinking, move with pace, and turn ideas into action. You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact across your team, the business, and for the clients we support every day. HUB24 Limited is an ASX-listed company (ASX: HUB) and part of the ASX100. We have over 1,100 employees across Australia, with offices in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth and the Gold Coast. Why you’ll enjoy working here We create an environment where you can do your best work and see the impact of it. Work with smart, collaborative people who get things done. Your ideas won’t sit in a backlog, they’ll be heard, tested and actioned. Grow your career your way, with support to learn, stretch and explore new opportunities. We also offer benefits to support you inside and outside of work: Genuinely flexible and hybrid ways of working. Employee Share Scheme. Additional leave and wellbeing support. Enhanced parental leave and support through different life stages. Everyday benefits, including discounts and financial wellbeing support. Why this is an exciting opportunity This is an exciting opportunity to join the Enterprise Solutions team as a Product Manager, supporting three strategic products: myprosperity, Engage and myHUB24. These products play a critical role in helping advisers, accountants and their clients connect people, data and digital experiences through seamless workflows, trusted information and intuitive digital solutions. Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering and key business stakeholders, you'll help shape product strategy, influence roadmap decisions and deliver meaningful outcomes for customers. In this role, you'll balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, using customer insights, market opportunities and data to drive product direction. You'll work across complex initiatives, identify opportunities to improve customer experiences and ensure solutions are scalable, commercially valuable and aligned to long-term business objectives. What You’ll Be Doing Lead product discovery activities to deeply understand customer, business and operational challenges before committing to solutions Define and measure product outcomes that align with customer value, business goals, operational efficiency and risk reduction Translate complex customer, business and technology requirements into clear product initiatives and actionable roadmaps Develop high-quality product documentation, including business cases, requirements, recommendations, trade-offs and decision-making artefacts Shape and manage the product roadmap, ensuring initiatives are prioritised and sequenced effectively to maximise value delivery Partner closely with UX, Engineering and Delivery teams to validate assumptions, improve customer journeys and deliver intuitive solutions Drive stakeholder alignment across senior business and technology leaders through clear communication and evidence-based recommendations Identify opportunities to create scalable, reusable capabilities rather than one-off solutions Manage dependencies, risks and competing priorities across multiple initiatives and teams Champion best-practice product management, outcome-led decision-making and continuous improvement Leverage strong technical knowledge of APIs, data technologies, identity management and modern delivery methodologies to inform product strategy and execution What You Bring You don’t need to tick every box, but experience in the below will set you up for success. Experience & Skills 8+ years Product Management experience within financial services, fintech, SaaS, technology or digital platform environments Strong experience working with advisers, accountants and/or wealth management customers, with a deep understanding of their workflows and needs Demonstrated experience designing, building and delivering API-led products and integrations Proven ability to define product vision, shape strategy and connect short-term delivery with long-term product goals Strong discovery and customer research skills, including problem framing, stakeholder engagement and validation techniques Experience defining product success metrics and using data-driven insights to inform decisions Exceptional communication and documentation skills, with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholder groups Experience managing cross-functional teams, dependencies and complex product initiatives Strong commercial acumen and the ability to balance customer needs, business priorities and technical considerations Collaborative leadership style with a proven ability to build trusted relationships across Product, Design, Engineering and business teams Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and navigate ambiguity with confidence Knowledge of financial services, digital platforms, data products and connected customer experiences highly regarded Our process We aim to keep the process simple and respectful of your time: You’ll receive an acknowledgement after applying. Our Talent team will review your application and keep you updated. If shortlisted, we’ll connect to learn more about you. Interviews may be virtual or in person. You’ll receive an outcome and feedback. If you need any adjustments, please let us know - we’re here to support you. Our commitment We’re committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and supported to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. Agencies, we work with a panel of preferred suppliers and are not accepting any unsolicited CVs.
